title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before putting tables or chairs in a public place for customers, or serving them food or drink there.

laws.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010

sources.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010
sources.locator: by-law 15(1) (version as in force at 5 August 2010)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not as part of a business involving the service of food or drink, without a permit: (a) provide tables or chairs in a public place for the use by the customers of that business; or
